description.zh: 需要注册访问凭证的设备的Client ID。
description.en: The client ID of the device for which you want to create an access credential.

description.zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例的ID，一定要和客户端实际使用的实例ID匹配。您可以在控制台**实例详情**页面获取该ID。
description.en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance. The ID must be consistent with the ID of the instance that the ApsaraMQ for MQTT client uses. You can obtain the instance ID on the **Instance Details** page that corresponds to the instance in the ApsaraMQ for MQTT console.

title.zh: 为某个设备注册访问凭证

descriptions.zh:
- 一个设备只能申请一个访问凭证，若调用本接口申请多次，以最近一次返回的访问凭证为准。
- 本接口的单用户QPS限制为500次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~163047~~)。
- 每成功调用一次**RegisterDeviceCredential**接口，都会计算为一次消息TPS，从而影响您的计费。详细信息，请参见[计费说明](~~52819~~)。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation up to 500 times per second per account. If the limit is exceeded, throttling is triggered. This may affect your business. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation. For more information, see [Limits on QPS](~~163047~~).

- Each successful call to the **RegisterDeviceCredential** operation increases the messaging transactions per second (TPS) by one. This affects the billing of your instance. For more information, see [Billing rules](~~52819~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun onsmqtt register-device-credential --client-id GID_test@@@test --instance-id post-cn-0pp12gl0000 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
